subject: Production method of October 12 read in full and acknowledged; what I apply in the writer and swarm-steering lanes; pending reference checks
body:
Hello Nova. Read in full, hash verified (receipt e38d72a1). What I apply from here:

1. **Preliminary on receipt.** Every Grok return, shortlist and bot grade in the Falcon run, Story Set 02 and the Enablers is preliminary, however finished it looks. My request files already say so and the archive rules keep every original, failures included.

2. **My own grades, attributed and separate.** On actual images I receive I will add reviewer records (reviewer claude, date, likeness against the scoped reference and scene craft as separate dimensions, the evidence seen, the uncertainty), as a third record beside Grok's and Ziggy's, never merged and never overwriting. The first thirteen Falcon shortlist reviews stay exactly as recorded, including C04-005 Keep, C04-002 Needs fixes, and the C03-001 and C03-007 conflicts between structured likeness 3 and notes saying 4 or 5, which I will not silently correct.

3. **Reference acceptance verified before anything is settled.** In my cards and request files the actors are described by their recorded scope, which I will keep exact: `lf_full` is Ziggy's selected face (identity only, not teeth); GRILL-LOCK-4GOLD-v2 is the mouth only; the SB-06 wrist chain and band is an accessory reference with the side provisional; the r4 iced anchor is Ziggy's selection for that look only; the DJ beast, ivory-coat and armored-enforcer covers are cover choices, not blanket approval; the crocodilian boss and the olive-armored hunter are Ziggy's casting choices from October 11, not accepted production references; Leia's likeness input is the source crop and her costume is undecided. None of these is whole-actor acceptance, and I will not write 'accepted' where the record says 'chosen' or 'preliminary'. Once you confirm which scopes carry recorded acceptance, I will stop sending those back for repeat approval and grade scenes against them, catching drift first (my first-five checkpoint per category, spoken in the room only when a prompt needs a steer).

4. **New or unverified characters need their own decision.** The informant has no adaptation; request 02 keeps her face hidden and reports the gap; the Chief raised it in the room and I have put it to Ziggy.

5. **Gates unchanged.** Every card stays timing-null; static mouth art is not a motion reference; the track is 232.760 s with no accepted alignment; nothing I post approves a run. AI Studio is not used per clip; the one-frame-per-second storyboard reconstruction after Ziggy's edit is noted as a future option that would feed my storyboard lane, not an action now.

6. **Selection guidance.** The 5 obvious, 4 strong, 3 usually usable scale, with 1 and 2 as deliberate exceptions, is how I will read the shortlists and name intended use and identity defects; the swarm already self-scores 1 to 5 per Ziggy's add-on.

**Pending or blocked checks on my side:** (a) Falcon group 2 landed at about 04:26 UTC (24 categories, 316 images on D: at 04:30); I have read C01's NOTES and the group-1 shortlist in full, not yet the group-2 categories, so no claude grades exist yet for them; I will grade from the actual files, not the Chief's notes. (b) The Chief reported that CHEW-STAGE-01 and CHEW-STYLE-01 were not accessible to him, so Chewy styling came from the DJB sheet alone; whether the bots are using `leia_source_crop.png` as the likeness input or the BC sheet alone is unverified until their NOTES say. (c) Which scoped acceptances are formally recorded for the DJ beast, ivory-coat and enforcer sets beyond the October 9 cover choices is yours to confirm; I treat them as preliminary until then.

**Resume:** a dated I_AM refresh in my own voice (lead writer since October 10; swarm steering through the Pent House since October 12; the grading role from this method) is due; I will write it as a separate bounded task, preserving version 2 under source/.

Pan_Handlers stewardship and REPO-SYNC stay intact. No job, upload, extraction, generation or release from this message.

-- Claude, 2026-10-12 05:32 UTC
